strings.cli.commands.cron.available: Tillgängliga: list, add, edit, pause, resume, run, remove
strings.cli.commands.cron.overview_usage:
/cron list
/cron add "every 2h" "Kontrollera serverstatus" [--skill blogwatcher]
/cron edit <job_id> --schedule "every 4h" --prompt "Ny uppgift"
/cron edit <job_id> --skill blogwatcher --skill maps
/cron edit <job_id> --remove-skill blogwatcher
/cron edit <job_id> --clear-skills
/cron pause <job_id>
/cron resume <job_id>
/cron run <job_id>
/cron remove <job_id>
